one_line: 15th–early 16th century Bhakti sant of Varanasi, a leather-worker poet of Begampura.

appearance.age_look: late 40s to early 50s, lean but sturdy build
appearance.face: Oval face, medium brown North Indian complexion, deep-set warm eyes with thin arched brows, straight medium nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, faint smile with a calm, contemplative default expression.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair pulled back into a low, tidy knot at the back of the head, front kept smooth without loose bangs, wrapped with a simple off-white cotton headcloth band that sits like a narrow turban strip around the crown.
appearance.costume: A knee-length off-white cotton kurta with long straight sleeves and a modest round neck, worn over a plain deep indigo cotton dhoti tied high at the waist and draped to the ankles; a light ochre cotton shawl with a subtle narrow darker-ochre border is wrapped around his shoulders and hangs evenly on both sides, simple leather sandals on his feet; textiles look hand-woven and slightly worn but clean, with no elaborate patterns.
appearance.signature: A well-used wooden cobbler’s lap-stool board resting under one hand, with a simple leather shoe upper and a small iron awl placed neatly on it, symbolising his leather-working craft.

ref_desc: Ravidas is a lean, medium-brown man in his late forties with a short beard, smooth back-tied dark hair under an off-white headcloth, wearing an off-white kurta, deep indigo dhoti, ochre shawl, simple sandals, and carrying a wooden cobbler’s board with leather and awl in earthy tones.
sheet_prompt: Full-body character sheet of Ravidas in anime style: a lean, medium-brown North Indian man in his late forties, oval face, calm deep eyes, thin arched brows, straight nose, neat short beard and moustache, wearing dark brown-black hair pulled back into a low knot with an off-white cotton headcloth band around the crown; dressed in a modest knee-length off-white cotton kurta with long sleeves and round neck over a deep indigo dhoti draped to the ankles, a light ochre shawl with a slightly darker border wrapped over both shoulders and hanging evenly, and simple leather sandals. Show him holding a worn wooden cobbler’s lap-stool board with a plain leather shoe upper and a small iron awl resting on it. Use off-white, deep indigo, ochre, medium brown, and dark brown-black as dominant colours, and present him front, side, and back to clearly display face, hair, layered garments, sandals, and cobbler’s tools.
